text:
karen_partners: CloudPartnerX asked for a lean RefKit: reference arch + Terraform modules + a simple cost CSV output. Want it publishable to their private registry. Who owns the module API?

diego_infra: I can draft module inputs. Keep consistent: accelerator_family, instance_count, disk_tier, region, tag_map. outputs: instance_ids, private_ips, role_attachment.

mina_devx: Repo layout suggestion:
/modules
  gpu/
  network/
/examples/simple-llm/
/tools/cost-estimator/
docs/compatibility.md

sam_security: Security checklist: ensure vars for kms_key_arn, iam_role_name. CI must redact secrets; use vault for test creds. Add guidance in docs/deployment-guides/security.md.

ci-bot: Draft CI created: refkit/ci/refkit-partnerx.yml  link: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/1500

diego_infra: cost-estimator: python script reading profiles.json -> CSV. sample CLI: `python cost.py --profile a2-ampere --hours 720`.

karen_partners: Timeline: partner demo next Tue. Action items: Diego = module API + samples (due Fri); Mina = repo skeleton + registry.md (due Mon); Sam = security doc stub (due Mon).

mina_devx: I'll add a minimal smoke test (local `plan` only) so partners can run without cloud creds. Will tag resources with team=partnerships.

karen_partners: Great. Please ping when PRs are up; I'll schedule the demo slot. :rocket:
